intelligence.human_view: The mockup was the proposal, not the verdict — and his eye is the verdict. The purple-filled pill was the flat color wash again (the Smart Mail lit pill, 22:50Z, all over again — a fill where a 3D object should be), the per-row points text was duplication (the same number said twice, on the row and in the strip), the star balls were almost sharp but not quite (the zoom test, SN-3179, applied to the glyph), and the buttons were pretty flat (the 3D law, SN-3181, unapplied to the very buttons that carry the block). Four small things, each fixable, each decisive. What he likes stays: the green intelligence, the value ranking, the rank rows themselves. The revision is the mockup becoming the build: every pill a real object in its own color, the points said once, the stars sharper, every button built the Naya way. That is what revised to 10/10 means — not a new design, but the same design finished, by his eye.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a beautiful toy you drew a picture of, and then someone who loves toys looks at your picture and says: this part isn't alive yet, this number is written twice, these stars could be sharper, and all the buttons are flat. And they also say what they love: the green stars, the gold stars, the rows themselves. So you fix the four little things and keep the things they love — and now the picture is a real toy, ten out of ten.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, he looked at the picture of the new ending and gave it a careful once-over: the little choice pills need to be real and alive, each in its own color, never a flat purple wash; the points should only be written once, down below, not twice on the row; the star balls need to be just a touch sharper; and every button needs to be built the proper way — dark and shiny, with light on top, pressing in and out. What he loves — the green for cleverness, the gold for value, the rows themselves — all stays. Four little fixes, and it is ten out of ten.
intelligence.naya_view: THE COMPOSER TYPE PILLS DON'T LOOK ALIVE — EACH PILL A REAL 3D OBJECT IN ITS OWN COLOR, NEVER A FLAT PURPLE FILL. THE PER-ROW POINTS READOUT GOES — THE POINTS TOTAL LIVES ONCE, IN THE VERDICT STRIP. THE STAR BALLS GO SLIGHTLY SHARPER. ALL THE BUTTONS GET THE NAYA BUTTON LOGIC. NOTHING FLAT ANYWHERE.
